STAFF-2015-2019.label: Staffing history 2015-2019
STAFF-2015-2019.note: Stable staffing; no major programs launched.
STAFF-2015-2019.text: Staffing history for the period 2015 to 2019. The institute employed an average of 38 research staff and 21 support staff. Staffing was stable across these years and no major programs were launched.

STAFF-2020-2024.label: Staffing history 2020-2024
STAFF-2020-2024.note: Research staff nearly doubled after the 2021 lab expansion.
STAFF-2020-2024.text: Staffing history for the period 2020 to 2024. The institute employed an average of 67 research staff and 24 support staff. Research staff nearly doubled following the 2021 Alchemy Lab expansion.

PERS-0042.label: Personnel file: head of Alchemy Lab
PERS-0042.name: Morgana Hexenmeister
PERS-0042.note: Led the 2021 lab expansion and the 2022 flux research program.
PERS-0042.text: Personnel file for the Head of the Alchemy Lab, Morgana Hexenmeister, born 1971-03-14, hired in 2009. She led the 2021 Alchemy Lab expansion and the 2022 flux research program.

PERS-0107.label: Personnel file: chief archivist
PERS-0107.name: Bartholomew Quill
PERS-0107.note: Maintains the institute's historical event register.
PERS-0107.text: Personnel file for the Chief Archivist, Bartholomew Quill, born 1958-11-02, hired in 1989. He maintains the institute's historical event register.

EVENTS-2015-2024.label: Institutional events 2015-2024
EVENTS-2015-2024.text: Institutional events from 2015 to 2024. In 2021 the Alchemy Lab expansion was completed. In 2022 the flux research program was launched. In 2024 the second experimental wing opened.
